import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['3 straights to 3 boxed']

fill = PatternFill(start_color='EBF1DE', end_color='EBF1DE', fill_type='solid')
bold = Font(bold=True)

for r in range(2, 17):

    b = int(ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value)
    c = int(ws.cell(row=r, column=4).value)
    s = ''.join(str(x) for x in sorted([a,b,c]))
    cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=7)
    cell.value = s
    cell.font = bold
    cell.fill = fill

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print("done")
EOF
